prompts.hero: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original editorial footwear campaign photograph for SOLEFORM's ivory, charcoal and lime ecommerce landing page. Create a premium, photorealistic landscape photograph, approximately 1536 x 1024. Low camera angle on a sculptural pale limestone staircase in a quiet modern architectural setting. Only the lower legs of an adult wearing charcoal tailored trousers, ribbed ivory socks, and an ORIGINAL UNBRANDED ivory mesh and suede sneaker with subtle acid-lime panels and a beautifully sculpted charcoal/cream outsole. One foot is stepping confidently onto the foreground step; shoe and real material detail dominate the center-right two thirds. The other leg is subtly visible behind. Strong directional late-afternoon light, deep olive-charcoal shadows, warm ivory stone, a restrained lime accent. Cinematic luxury-fashion art direction, analog editorial texture, tactile suede and mesh, precise realistic laces, attractive natural shoe proportions. Compose the main shoe around center-right at 52 percent height so it remains fully visible in portrait crops. Leave the upper quarter calmer. Keep the leftmost quarter mostly architectural texture. No typography, no logos, no swoosh, no stripes, no branding, no watermark, no UI, no collage. This is a new original concept campaign, not a copy of any brand advertisement.
prompts.collections: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a THREE-PANEL editorial footwear lifestyle contact sheet for the SOLEFORM Men, Women and Kids collection cards. Create one landscape image approximately 1536 x 1024 divided into exactly THREE EQUAL vertical photographic columns, no gaps, no borders, no text. All three shots should have the polished tactile natural realism of a luxury footwear editorial and harmonize in warm ivory, charcoal, olive and a small lime accent. LEFT PANEL MEN: low angle cropped adult's legs in relaxed charcoal trousers and ivory socks, wearing an original unbranded taupe suede retro sneaker with a charcoal outsole, paused by a warm stone city bench. CENTER PANEL WOMEN: adult woman's lower legs in warm ivory wide-leg trousers, wearing an original unbranded sculptural ivory and muted olive chunky sneaker on pale limestone outdoor steps; confident casual styling. RIGHT PANEL KIDS: a child's lower legs in sand-coloured trousers, wearing an original playful lime and cream velcro sneaker with a soft rounded silhouette at an olive-coloured playground step; no face, no adult posing. DISTINCT footwear designs and DISTINCT compositions in each panel. Every pair of shoes must sit around the vertical CENTER of its panel, with shoes completely visible between 32 and 65 percent height, because the contact sheet will be vertically center-cropped into collection cards. Directional sunlight, genuine shoe/material and pavement detail, convincing foot anatomy, editorial grain, calm backgrounds, tasteful negative space above and below. No faces, no typography, no brand logos, no swooshes, no stripes, no watermark, no UI. Original concepts, not copies of genuine branded products.
